title: contract/vectors/index.json
description: The list of vector families every implementation runs, and how many cases each consumer must run per group. A consumer reads this first, runs exactly the groups that name it with exactly one adapter each, and fails when a file is missing or when it ran a different number of cases than its count here. The $defs below are shared by every family schema.

schema.description: The schema in contract/schemas the file validates against.

layout.description: groups: the file holds groups of cases {name, purpose, consumers, tags, input, expect}. flat: the file is one array of vectors, each its own input; only the hash family has it.

section.description: The section of v3.md the family pins.

reference.description: The zero-dependency reference implementation, relative to contract/. It exports FAMILIES and run(group, input).

generator.description: Where the cases are stated by hand, relative to contract/.

consumers.description: How many of the group's cases each consumer runs. A consumer missing here runs none of them and has no adapter for the group.

purpose.description: Why the case exists, in a sentence a person can act on when it fails.

tags.description: What a case is for. finding:<code> names the review finding it pins; injection and agent-enforced are reserved for the transport and setup-acceptance families.
